image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of a vintage typewriter keyboard. The focus is on the rows of round, glass-topped keys with metal stems. At the bottom center, a long, rectangular, cream-colored key (the space bar) is visible. The background shows the metallic body of the typewriter and part of the carriage return lever mechanism.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated rectangular key spanning the full width of the bottom keyboard row.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The key is elongated and rectangular, but it does not span the 'full width' of the row; there are distinct keys and mechanical structures to its left and right.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Length is dramatically greater than any other key, roughly ten times the width of a standard letter key.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The space bar is significantly longer than the round type-keys above it, fitting the relative proportion description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Surface is flat or slightly concave.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The surface appears flat and smooth, consistent with a vintage plastic or metal key cap.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Underside connects to a long stabilizer bar mechanism.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The underside of the key is completely occluded by the keycap itself and the angle of the photo; only the top surface is visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Label is typically blank with no printed character.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible surface of the space bar is plain cream color with no text or symbols.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Positioned centrally between modifier keys on the bottom row.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: It is located in the center of the bottom-most row of keys, flanked by what appear to be shift-lock or margin-release levers/keys.
The key has a smooth, non-glossy finish consistent with aged plastic or painted metal found on vintage typewriters.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Typically white, black, or gray to match keyboard color scheme.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The key is cream/off-white, which matches the color scheme of the surrounding beige/cream typewriter body and key stems.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Part of a standard computer or typewriter keyboard.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The object is clearly integrated into a mechanical typewriter keyboard assembly.

alignment_reasoning: The image correctly identifies and displays a space bar within its natural context (a typewriter). It passes most checkpoints regarding shape, label, position, and material. It fails one geometric checkpoint because the space bar does not span the *entire* width of the device (it is flanked by other controls), which is a characteristic distinction of typewriter space bars versus modern computer keyboard space bars. However, as a representation of the class 'space bar', it is highly accurate.
artifact_reasoning: No AI-generation artifacts detected. The image exhibits natural photographic characteristics, including consistent lighting, realistic reflections on the glass keys, and appropriate depth of field blur. Structural integrity is sound.
